title: 법원조사관 등 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Investigation Officers)
(1) Court investigation officers shall be designated from among Grade IV or Grade V court public officials, fixed-term public officials, or public officials seconded under Article 54-3 (3) of the Court Organization Act. [Amended on September 28, 2009, and June 28, 2021.]
(2) Family investigation officers, juvenile case investigation officers, domestic protection case investigation officers, and child protection case investigation officers shall be designated from among investigation chief administrative officers, investigation administrative officers, senior investigation clerks, junior investigation clerks, or fixed-term public officials of equivalent rank. Provided, however, that where special circumstances exist, they may be designated from among chief court administrative officers, court administrative officers, senior court clerks, or junior court clerks. [Amended on December 10, 2013, and September 1, 2014.]
